STIX Two Math 2.13b171 — mathematical symbol fonts

Source: https://github.com/stipub/stixfonts/tree/v2.13b171
Original: fonts/static_ttf/STIXTwoMath-Regular.ttf

The browser uses the DSH Math Symbols WOFF2 subset for U+20E5, U+2201,
and U+2AFD. Proper-set signs use the separate KaTeX-derived DSH Set Relations
browser font. The complement has a straight upright stem and short inward
terminals, with a 712-unit height. The slanted parallel lines have a
720-unit height, preserving their slope and 74-unit horizontal rule width.
Their centered U+20E5 negation stroke has a 374-unit height and 57-unit
horizontal rule width. Font revision and name records identify version 1.5.
All other outlines retain the upstream design.

Rebuild the browser subset with fontTools and Brotli from the upstream font:

python build-subset.py STIXTwoMath-Regular.ttf STIXTwoMath-Symbols.woff2

Browser SHA-256: b72d087bca0a16b98916c286d6bd31d444cd1840d414e3c2e001582b4c7a7c7d
